slots.image_prompt: A dark futuristic cover background featuring an expansive particle grid network, glowing nodes and connecting lines forming a dynamic mesh pattern reminiscent of open source connectivity. Deep midnight blue base with sky blue (#2196F3) and electric cyan (#00E5FF) luminous accents. Subtle volumetric light rays pierce through the particle field from the right side, creating depth and atmosphere. The overall mood is mysterious, technological, and aspirational, evoking the boundless potential of collaborative innovation in the digital age.

A dark tech-styled section divider background featuring an abstract horizontal timeline motif with glowing circular nodes connected by luminous lines. Deep navy blue base with sky blue (#2196F3) and electric cyan (#00E5FF) accents. Faint grid patterns and digital circuit traces weave through the composition. Soft volumetric haze adds atmospheric depth, while the right side features fading information bands with gradient transparency. Mood is futuristic, structured, and navigational.

A dark futuristic scene showing a stack of abstract glowing books floating in mid-air, each book emitting soft cyan and sky blue light from its pages and edges. Books are arranged in an elegant cascade with holographic light particles drifting around them. Deep midnight blue background with subtle geometric grid patterns. The overall mood conveys knowledge accumulation, intellectual depth, and the weight of learning. Sky blue (#2196F3) and electric cyan (#00E5FF) color palette throughout.

A dark tech-styled abstract composition divided into four subtle zones, each containing a different glowing iconographic silhouette: a streaming camera lens, a microphone waveform, a document page with horizontal lines, and a radio broadcast tower. Icons rendered in minimalist line-art style with sky blue (#2196F3) and electric cyan (#00E5FF) glow effects against a deep navy background. Subtle connecting network lines weave between the four zones, symbolizing the web of knowledge dissemination and community sharing.

A dark futuristic concept visualization showing an abstract four-quadrant network structure, with luminous nodes connected by glowing neural-like pathways radiating from a central hub. Deep midnight blue background with sky blue (#2196F3) primary nodes and electric cyan (#00E5FF) connecting filaments. Ethereal particle effects float in the space between quadrants. The composition evokes a knowledge ecosystem — interconnected ideas forming a living intellectual network. Mood is contemplative, expansive, and intellectually charged.

A dark tech-styled directional background featuring bold abstract forward-pointing arrow shapes and meandering luminous paths cutting through a deep navy blue void. Sky blue (#2196F3) and electric cyan (#00E5FF) light trails guide the eye diagonally across the frame. Subtle geometric grid overlays and fading particle clouds add depth. The overall mood is dynamic, purposeful, and aspirational — evoking forward momentum and actionable intent in a futuristic landscape.

A dark tech-styled abstract composition featuring floating translucent code panels and speech bubble silhouettes arranged in a vertical cascade. Glowing lines of abstract syntax — rendered as decorative illuminated bars rather than legible text — cascade alongside rounded conversation bubbles. Deep midnight blue background with sky blue (#2196F3) structural frames and electric cyan (#00E5FF) accent highlights. The mood is professional, collaborative, and methodical, evoking disciplined engineering practice and constructive dialogue.

A dark futuristic closing scene featuring a radiant burst of light emanating from the center, with streams of luminous particles converging inward from all directions to form a brilliant focal point. Deep midnight blue background transitions to glowing sky blue (#2196F3) and electric cyan (#00E5FF) near the center. Concentric rings of light pulse outward like ripples. The composition evokes unity, gratitude, and the dawn of a new journey. Mood is hopeful, celebratory, and expansive.
